patch.value: Rewrite reachable history before public release approval

The current tree has no host-specific path match, but reachable history contains personal identities and host-specific absolute paths. This must be resolved and independently reviewed before any npm/public-release claim; the bounded pm 2026.8.7 merge-fence tranche must not rewrite history or publish.

A planned recoverable history rewrite removes or approvedly maps all personal identities and host-specific paths across every reachable ref; full-history secret/privacy scanners pass; raw and PM history are independently reviewed; downstream coordination is documented; maintainer explicitly approves publication
All 136 commits reachable from local refs on pm-presets main at 853dd8e
Enumerate unique git author identities and scan every reachable commit for absolute /home, /Users, and Windows user paths.
All reachable history contains only approved public identities and no private host paths, personal data, secrets, or keys; independent review and maintainer approval explicitly clear publication.
Six unique name/email identity pairs include personal identities, and 66 of 136 reachable commits contain a host-specific absolute path pattern; current tracked content has zero host-path matches.

message: Track independent reachable-history privacy publication blocker
